description: Learn Thai phonics and reading rules.
description_pt: Aprenda a fonética e regras de leitura tailandesas.

cards.question: กะ
cards.explanation: Short standard 'a' sound. Forces dead syllable if no final consonant. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กา
cards.explanation: Long standard 'aa' sound. Creates live syllable. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กิ
cards.explanation: Short 'i' sound placed directly above the consonant. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กี
cards.explanation: Long 'ee' sound placed directly above the consonant. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กึ
cards.explanation: Short unrounded back vowel (close back unrounded). (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กือ
cards.explanation: Long unrounded back vowel. Requires trailing อ if no final consonant. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กุ
cards.explanation: Short 'u' sound (like oo in foot) placed below. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กู
cards.explanation: Long 'oo' sound (like oo in boot) placed below. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกะ
cards.explanation: Short 'e' sound. Vowel wraps around the consonant. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เก
cards.explanation: Long 'ay' sound placed to the left of the consonant. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: แกะ
cards.explanation: Short 'ae' sound (like 'a' in cat). Wrap-around structure. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: แก
cards.explanation: Long 'ae' sound (like 'a' in bad) placed to the left. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: โกะ
cards.explanation: Short 'o' sound. Disappears completely when final consonant is added. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: โก
cards.explanation: Long 'oh' sound placed to the left of the consonant. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกาะ
cards.explanation: Short open 'o' sound (like 'aw' in law). Wrap-around. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กอ
cards.explanation: Long open 'o' sound. The letter 'อ' functions purely as a vowel here. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกิอะ
cards.explanation: Short central vowel (like 'er' in British 'her'). Very rare. (Type: Short Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกอ
cards.explanation: Long central vowel. Changes form to เ—ิ when final consonant attached. (Type: Long Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกียะ
cards.explanation: Short diphthong 'i-a'. Rare modern usage. (Type: Short Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกีย
cards.explanation: Long diphthong moving from 'ee' to 'ah' smoothly. (Type: Long Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกือะ
cards.explanation: Short diphthong combining unrounded back vowel + 'a'. (Type: Short Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกือ
cards.explanation: Long diphthong combining unrounded back vowel + 'ah'. (Type: Long Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กัวะ
cards.explanation: Short diphthong combining 'u' + 'a' with final glottal stop. (Type: Short Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กัว
cards.explanation: Long diphthong 'oo-ah'. Drops the upper symbol when final consonant attached. (Type: Long Diphthong, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กำ
cards.explanation: Combines short 'a' sound with a final '-m' closing sound. (Type: Special Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: ไก
cards.explanation: Short 'ai' sound. Most common 'ai' vowel layout. (Type: Special Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: ใก
cards.explanation: Short 'ai' sound. Restricted to exactly 20 grammar words in Thai. (Type: Special Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: เกา
cards.explanation: Short/Medium 'ao' sound like 'ow' in cow. (Type: Special Vowel, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: กา
cards.explanation: Meaning: Chicken. Mid Class + Long Vowel = Mid Tone. (Type: Consonant Anchor, Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: คน
cards.explanation: Hidden short 'o' vowel (โกะ pattern) triggers when two consonants sit with no visible vowel. (Type: Word (Hidden Vowel), Tone: Mid, Class: Low)

cards.question: มา
cards.explanation: High frequency word meaning 'to come'. Low class + long vowel = mid tone. (Type: Word (Standard), Tone: Mid, Class: Low)

cards.question: กิน
cards.explanation: High frequency word meaning 'to eat'. Mid class + short vowel + live ending = mid tone. (Type: Word (Standard), Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: นอน
cards.explanation: Means 'to sleep'. Uses อ as the long aww vowel block with a live final n. (Type: Word (Standard), Tone: Mid, Class: Low)

cards.question: รัก
cards.explanation: Means 'to love'. Short vowel + dead ending (k) on a Low Class consonant shifts tone to HIGH. (Type: Word (Dead Syllable), Tone: High, Class: Low)

cards.question: เรียน
cards.explanation: Means 'to study'. Demonstrates the full long diphthong เ—ีย structure ending in live -n. (Type: Word (Diphthong), Tone: Mid, Class: Low)

cards.question: ไป
cards.explanation: Means 'to go'. Left-side vowel ไ structure. Mid class + special vowel = mid tone. (Type: Word (Special Vowel), Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: บ้าน
cards.explanation: Means 'house/home'. Mid class + live ending + Mai Tho marker = FALLING tone. (Type: Word (Tone Marker), Tone: Falling, Class: Mid)

cards.question: ไม่
cards.explanation: Means 'no/not'. Low class + Mai Ek marker shifts the rule strictly to a FALLING tone. (Type: Word (Tone Marker), Tone: Falling, Class: Low)

cards.question: น่ะ
cards.explanation: Grammar particle. Low class + short vowel + Mai Ek = FALLING tone. (Type: Word (Tone Marker), Tone: Falling, Class: Low)

cards.question: กวน
cards.explanation: Means 'to agitate/stir'. Notice the upper component of —ัว is dropped when a final consonant (น) joins. (Type: Word (Diphthong Shift), Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: การ
cards.explanation: Prefix for making verbs nouns. Letter ร (r) shifts strictly to an 'n' final sound in Thai. (Type: Word (Final Shift), Tone: Mid, Class: Mid)

cards.question: พูด
cards.explanation: Means 'to speak'. Low class consonant + long vowel + dead ending (t) shifts tone to FALLING. (Type: Word (Dead Syllable), Tone: Falling, Class: Low)
